svg.title: Actuary — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as actuary, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A probability curve is clearly separated from its chart axes above a sparse three-column observation table. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
